title: marketintell
description: AI analyst desk for stocks, options & crypto with sourced trade setups and a public accuracy record.
summary: AI analyst desk for stocks, options & crypto with sourced trade setups and a public accuracy record.
offersHint: AI analyst desk for stocks, options & crypto with sourced trade setups and a public accuracy record. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.marketintell.ai/mcp · Packages: npm:marketintell · Optional headers: X-API-Key · Env vars: MARKETINTELL_API_KEY

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: API key from https://marketintell.ai/signup (or SHA-256 PoW self-signup at https://api.marketintell.ai/v1/auth/challenge). Capability-discovery methods (initialize, tools/list, resources/list, prompts/list, ping) succeed without a key; tools/call and resources/read require one.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: API key. SSE transport is the legacy long-lived channel; new clients should prefer the Streamable HTTP endpoint above.

environmentVariables.name: MARKETINTELL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the underlying MarketIntell account. Required for tool calls; optional for capability discovery.

toolsPreview.name: chat
toolsPreview.description: Run a query through MarketIntell's brain (auto-routes to T1 fast agent or T2 CoT pipeline based on intent). Returns synthesized analysis with citations and trade setup when relevant.

toolsPreview.name: chat_deep
toolsPreview.description: Run a query through MarketIntell's T3 supervisor — parallel specialists across technical/derivatives/macro/social/onchain/etc. plus synthesis. Slower (~25-40s) and costlier than `chat`. Pro tier only.

toolsPreview.name: alpha_signals
toolsPreview.description: Fetch recent alpha signals — automated market intelligence. Crypto signals every ~10 min; equities (Beta) every ~30 min during US market hours. Filter by domain to narrow.

toolsPreview.name: signal_performance
toolsPreview.description: Realized signal accuracy — rolling 30-day win rate over CLOSED trade signals, where a win is a real take-profit / in-profit expiry (net positive after fees & leverage) and a loss is a real stop-loss / losing expiry. Win-rate is over resolved signals only; flat (break-even) and cancelled/no-fill/ambiguous signals are reported but excluded from the rate. Broken down by timeframe and direction.

toolsPreview.name: screener
toolsPreview.description: Token screening — find trending tokens, top gainers, and top losers. Use this to discover what's moving in the market right now.

toolsPreview.name: portfolio_list
toolsPreview.description: List all portfolios owned by the authenticated key. Returns id, name, holdings, timestamps.

toolsPreview.name: portfolio_create
toolsPreview.description: Create a new portfolio for the authenticated key. Holdings are token symbol + amount (+ optional entry_price and notes).

toolsPreview.name: portfolio_analyze
toolsPreview.description: Compute PnL + risk assessment for a portfolio you own. Returns per-holding pnl, risk_assessment, and top_risks.

toolsPreview.name: sessions_list
toolsPreview.description: List the authenticated key's recent chat sessions. Useful to resume prior conversations.

toolsPreview.name: billing_status
toolsPreview.description: Return the authenticated key's plan, daily quota usage, monthly LLM-cost-cents, and cap. Mirrors GET /v1/billing/status.

toolsPreview.name: health
toolsPreview.description: MarketIntell system health — uptime, cache stats, memory, provider circuit-breaker states.

toolsPreview.name: register_challenge
toolsPreview.description: Step 1 of MCP self-signup. Returns a proof-of-work challenge. Solve locally (find a nonce whose sha256 has the required leading zero hex chars), then call `register` with { challenge_id, nonce, name }.

toolsPreview.name: register
toolsPreview.description: Step 2 of MCP self-signup. Submit the challenge id + solved nonce to provision a fresh Free-tier API key. The key is shown ONCE — store it. Pro upgrades go through Stripe checkout; this tool only issues Free keys.

toolsPreview.name: execute_propose_intent
toolsPreview.description: Propose a trade intent to the user's connected broker. Writes a pending row the user reviews + approves. Requires `trade` scope. Use this when an agent wants to act on a signal without placing the order itself.

toolsPreview.name: execute_approve_intent
toolsPreview.description: Approve a pending trade intent and place the order at the broker. Returns the executed_order audit row. Requires `trade` scope.

toolsPreview.name: execute_list_intents
toolsPreview.description: List the caller's recent trade intents (pending, executed, rejected). Requires `trade` scope.

toolsPreview.name: execute_read_portfolio
toolsPreview.description: Read the caller's connected broker account snapshot — equity, cash, buying power, open positions. Requires `trade` scope.
